_about: MASTER_LAB01 door controller enclosure - every dimension in mm. Edit, then run build.ps1 to regenerate all parts in SOLIDWORKS. Confidence labels (2026-10-20 research, reports/Door enclosure component dimensions.md): DATASHEET = manufacturer drawing for the exact part; VARIANT = drawing of the matching board variant; REFERENCE = similar part / other seller; CHOSEN = design choice; MEASURE = check with calipers or the fit coupon before the full print. No speaker / PAM8403 (removed by the owner 2026-10-20).

envelope._status: CHOSEN: fits a 220 x 220 bed printed back-down; interference check in out/interference.txt; 45 mm wire space between the plate modules (top z 40) and the front modules (bottom z 85); depth 90 -> 110 on 2026-10-20 (owner: more room for wires).

fasteners._pilot_status: CHOSEN pilot for M2.5 self-tapping (PT/KA) screws into PLA/PETG; coupon has 2.0 / 2.2 / 2.4 Pilot stays UNDER size on purpose (screw cuts its thread).

fingerprint._ref: DATASHEET (GROW R307 manual v1.20 p.2) for Most ME-30297: body 44.1 x 20 x 23.5, no flange / ears, sensing window 15 x 11.19, 'window dimension 19 x 21' (prism head face), side notches 1.5 deep 22.9 from the sensor end, connector 3.2 below the base. Tolerances not published.
fingerprint._aperture_status: 0.3 RULE (owner + printer operator, Elegoo Neptune 4, 2026-10-21): clearance fits = part + 0.3; body 44.1 x 20 -> pocket 44.4 x 20.3; head face 21 x 19 -> 21.3 x 19.3; coupon also 21.6 x 19.6. If the module measures ~52 long it is an R307S body: change body_l / pocket_l.
fingerprint._mount_status: OWNER 2026-10-24: the finger goes on the sensor's END (the 45-degree glass); the end measures 19.7 x 23.2 (caliper) -> opening 20.0 x 23.5 (0.3 rule). The sensor stands OUT of the panel 15 mm (box hangs on the wall, easy to reach). Behind the panel: a sleeve (wall 2.5) as long as the rest of the body (44.1 - 15 - panel 4 = 25.1), a back stop (3 mm ledges left/right, wires pass in the middle) so a pressing finger cannot push it in, and one M2.5 self-tapping screw through the sleeve wall clamps the body so it cannot be pulled out. body_l 44.1 is the datasheet length - measure it if the stop does not touch.
fingerprint._length_measured: MEASURED (owner, caliper, 2026-10-24): body 46.1 long on the bottom (long side, under the 45-degree glass), 32.45 on the top -> sleeve behind the panel 46.1 - 15 - 4 = 27.1 (was 44.1 datasheet). Wires leave the back end.

wires._measured: MEASURED (owner, digital caliper, 2026-10-24) + 0.3 clearance: Dupont housing 2.48 square, wire D1.3 -> every wire slot / pass-through >= 2.78

esp32cam._measured: MEASURED (owner, caliper, 2026-10-24) + 0.3: ESP32-CAM on ESP32-CAM-MB, stack 27.26 x 40.21 x ~13 -> pocket 27.56 x 40.51 x 13.3; camera square 8.04 -> 8.34 recess from the rear, lens D7.89 -> D8.19 hole through a 1.2 front skin. Mounted UPRIGHT (camera at the top, picture not rotated), left of the LCD, lens at y 175 (higher than the LCD = nearer face height); the MB's USB cable leaves downward (open bottom of the holder). The stack self-locates: the camera block goes into the square recess until it (or the SD holder) stops. Holder: walls left / right / top, 3 mm longer than the stack, a zip tie through the long side slots goes behind the MB. ESTIMATES (photo, not measured): lens centre 9 below the board top and 1 left of centre; flash LED 9 right of centre, 6 above the bottom edge -> D4.5 hole (owner: 'small hole for the white flash LED').

Left-right offset still a photo estimate. MEASURED 2026-10-24: RIGHT edge (camera side facing you) to the camera block 8.48 -> lens 12.50 from the right edge, board centre 13.63 -> lens 1.13 RIGHT of centre (owner corrected).
